quests.question: You wonder how scientists invent new medicines to help sick people feel better. Who works on discoveries like that?
quests.hint: You wonder how scientists invent new medicines to help sick people feel better. Who works on discoveries like that?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a chemist. Chemists mix and test chemicals to make new discoveries.
quests.funFact: A chemist mixes tiny amounts of different substances to see what happens!
quests.wordExample: The chemist mixed two liquids carefully in the lab.

quests.question: You want to send someone a beautiful bouquet of flowers for their birthday. Who could arrange it?
quests.hint: You want to send someone a beautiful bouquet of flowers for their birthday. Who could arrange it?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a florist. Florists arrange and sell beautiful flowers.
quests.funFact: A florist learns which flowers look beautiful when arranged together.
quests.wordExample: The florist arranged a beautiful bouquet for the wedding.

quests.question: The windows on a tall office building look streaky and dirty. Who cleans them so they sparkle again?
quests.hint: The windows on a tall office building look streaky and dirty. Who cleans them so they sparkle again?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a window cleaner. Window cleaners wash windows until they sparkle.
quests.funFact: A window cleaner on a tall building may work high above the street!
quests.wordExample: The window cleaner cleaned every window on the tall building.

quests.question: The _____ helped the visitor understand the doctor's questions.
quests.hint: The _____ helped the visitor understand the doctor's questions.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is an interpreter. Interpreters listen in one language and speak the meaning in another right away.
quests.funFact: Some interpreters work at big meetings with people from many countries.
quests.wordExample: The interpreter helped the visitor understand the doctor's questions.

quests.question: You want to know whether it will rain during your outdoor birthday party this weekend. Who could tell you?
quests.hint: You want to know whether it will rain during your outdoor birthday party this weekend. Who could tell you?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a meteorologist. Meteorologists study the sky and tell us what the weather will be.
quests.funFact: Meteorologists study clouds, wind, and temperature every single day.
quests.wordExample: The meteorologist predicted rain for the weekend.

quests.question: You wonder why one plant in the garden grows so much taller than the one right next to it. Who studies questions like that?
quests.hint: You wonder why one plant in the garden grows so much taller than the one right next to it. Who studies questions like that?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a botanist. Botanists study plants and how they grow.
quests.funFact: Botanists study how plants use sunlight, water, and soil to grow.
quests.wordExample: The botanist studied the leaves of a new plant.

quests.question: Water is leaking out from under your kitchen sink. Who could come fix it?
quests.hint: Water is leaking out from under your kitchen sink. Who could come fix it?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a plumber. Plumbers fix pipes so water flows where it should.
quests.funFact: A plumber can find a hidden leak just by listening carefully!
quests.wordExample: The plumber fixed the leaking pipe under the sink.

quests.question: You want to find out what's really happening in your town this week. Who reports the news?
quests.hint: You want to find out what's really happening in your town this week. Who reports the news?
quests.explanation: Nice work! This is a journalist. Journalists research and write news stories for newspapers or TV.
quests.funFact: A journalist checks facts carefully before sharing a story.
quests.wordExample: The journalist interviewed the mayor about the new park.

quests.question: You ordered a new toy online and it's finally arriving today. Who brings it to your house?
quests.hint: You ordered a new toy online and it's finally arriving today. Who brings it to your house?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a delivery driver. Delivery drivers bring packages straight to your front door.
quests.funFact: A delivery driver might drop off hundreds of packages in one day!
quests.wordExample: The delivery driver left a package on our porch.

quests.question: You visit a museum and see dinosaur bones displayed perfectly behind glass. Who arranged them that way?
quests.hint: You visit a museum and see dinosaur bones displayed perfectly behind glass. Who arranged them that way?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a museum curator. Museum curators choose and organize the objects shown in a museum.
quests.funFact: A museum curator decides exactly how to display each object so visitors can enjoy it!
quests.wordExample: The museum curator arranged the new exhibit carefully.

quests.question: You want to find out who your great-great-grandparents were and how everyone is connected. Who could help you trace your family tree?
quests.hint: You want to find out who your great-great-grandparents were and how everyone is connected. Who could help you trace your family tree?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a genealogist. Genealogists research family history and trace family trees.
quests.funFact: A genealogist can trace a family's story back hundreds of years!
quests.wordExample: The genealogist found an old photo of my great-grandparents.

quests.question: This person travels to discover unknown places for the very first time, rather than showing visitors around a place that's already well known. Are they an explorer or a tour guide?
quests.hint: This person travels to discover unknown places for the very first time, rather than showing visitors around a place that's already well known. Are they an explorer or a tour guide?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an explorer. Explorers travel to new places to discover and learn about them.
quests.funFact: Some explorers keep detailed journals of every new place they discover.
quests.wordExample: The explorer wrote about the new island in her journal.

quests.question: You meet someone who speaks a language you don't know, but you really want to talk with them. Who could help you both understand each other?
quests.hint: You meet someone who speaks a language you don't know, but you really want to talk with them. Who could help you both understand each other?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a translator. Translators help people who speak different languages understand each other.
quests.funFact: A translator has to think very quickly to change words between languages.
quests.wordExample: The translator changed the letter from English into Spanish.

quests.question: You wonder exactly where the cheese on your sandwich came from. Who made it?
quests.hint: You wonder exactly where the cheese on your sandwich came from. Who made it?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a cheese maker. Cheese makers turn milk into many kinds of cheese.
quests.funFact: A cheese maker can turn the same milk into hundreds of different cheeses!
quests.wordExample: The cheese maker checked on the cheese aging in the cool room.

quests.question: Your parents have plans tonight and need someone trustworthy to stay home with you. Who could that be?
quests.hint: Your parents have plans tonight and need someone trustworthy to stay home with you. Who could that be?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a babysitter. Babysitters take care of children while their parents are away.
quests.funFact: Babysitters make sure children eat, play, and get to bed on time.
quests.wordExample: The babysitter read us a bedtime story.

quests.question: You wonder exactly how a cartoon character on screen manages to move and talk so smoothly. Who draws that?
quests.hint: You wonder exactly how a cartoon character on screen manages to move and talk so smoothly. Who draws that?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an animator. Animators draw and design characters so they appear to move.
quests.funFact: Animators bring cartoon characters to life one drawing at a time.
quests.wordExample: The animator made the character's smile look just right.

quests.question: Your hair has grown much too long and needs a trim. Who could cut it for you?
quests.hint: Your hair has grown much too long and needs a trim. Who could cut it for you?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a hairdresser. Hairdressers wash, cut, and style people's hair.
quests.funFact: Some hairdressers can finish a haircut in less than twenty minutes!
quests.wordExample: The hairdresser washed and styled her hair carefully.

quests.question: You're ready to pay for groceries at the checkout line. Who rings everything up for you?
quests.hint: You're ready to pay for groceries at the checkout line. Who rings everything up for you?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a cashier. Cashiers help you pay for the things you buy at a store.
quests.funFact: Cashiers have to count money quickly and carefully.
quests.wordExample: The cashier scanned our groceries and gave us the receipt.

quests.question: Scientists want to warn people living nearby before a volcano erupts. Who studies volcanoes closely enough to help with that?
quests.hint: Scientists want to warn people living nearby before a volcano erupts. Who studies volcanoes closely enough to help with that?
quests.explanation: Great job! This is a volcanologist. Volcanologists study volcanoes to understand how and when they might erupt.
quests.funFact: A volcanologist studies rock and gas to help warn people before an eruption!
quests.wordExample: The volcanologist studied the rock near the volcano.

quests.question: You want to learn how to build a healthy, balanced plate of food. Who could help you plan one?
quests.hint: You want to learn how to build a healthy, balanced plate of food. Who could help you plan one?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a nutritionist. Nutritionists help people learn how to eat healthy meals.
quests.funFact: Nutritionists help athletes plan meals that give them plenty of energy.
quests.wordExample: The nutritionist helped plan a healthy school lunch.

quests.question: You wonder how engineers build a robot that can walk around and pick things up on its own. Who designs robots like that?
quests.hint: You wonder how engineers build a robot that can walk around and pick things up on its own. Who designs robots like that?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a robotics engineer. Robotics engineers design and build robots.
quests.funFact: Robotics engineers build robots that can explore places too dangerous for people.
quests.wordExample: The robotics engineer tested the robot's new arm.

quests.question: You want to learn a new hobby by watching someone explain it step by step online. Who might have filmed that video?
quests.hint: You want to learn a new hobby by watching someone explain it step by step online. Who might have filmed that video?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a vlogger. Vloggers record videos to share stories and ideas online.
quests.funFact: A vlogger might film and edit a video for hours before sharing it!
quests.wordExample: The vlogger edited the video before sharing it online.

quests.question: Your mom wants a warm drink on her way to work. Who makes it for her at the cafe?
quests.hint: Your mom wants a warm drink on her way to work. Who makes it for her at the cafe?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a barista. Baristas make and serve coffee and other drinks at a cafe.
quests.funFact: A skilled barista can pour a pretty leaf pattern into warm milk!
quests.wordExample: The barista made a warm drink for my mom.

quests.question: You wonder how someone came up with the very first idea for a brand-new kind of machine. Who does work like that?
quests.hint: You wonder how someone came up with the very first idea for a brand-new kind of machine. Who does work like that?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is an inventor. Inventors design and create brand-new things that did not exist before.
quests.funFact: Some famous inventions started as a simple sketch on paper.
quests.wordExample: The inventor tested her new invention in the garage.

quests.question: You want to find a great book about dinosaurs but don't know where to look. Who could help you find one?
quests.hint: You want to find a great book about dinosaurs but don't know where to look. Who could help you find one?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a librarian. Librarians help people find and borrow books at the library.
quests.funFact: A librarian can help you find one book among thousands on the shelves!
quests.wordExample: The librarian helped me find a book about dinosaurs.

quests.question: Someone needs a careful operation to fix a problem deep inside their body. Who performs it?
quests.hint: Someone needs a careful operation to fix a problem deep inside their body. Who performs it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a surgeon. Surgeons are doctors who perform operations to fix problems inside the body.
quests.funFact: Surgeons wash their hands for several minutes before every single operation.
quests.wordExample: The surgeon washed her hands before the operation began.

quests.question: You're visiting a new city and need a quick ride to your hotel. Who could you call?
quests.hint: You're visiting a new city and need a quick ride to your hotel. Who could you call?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a taxi driver. Taxi drivers drive passengers safely to the place they want to go.
quests.funFact: Taxi drivers use a meter to show how much a ride costs.
quests.wordExample: The taxi driver took us straight to the airport.

quests.question: Something important has gone missing and nobody knows exactly what happened. Who could investigate and solve the mystery?
quests.hint: Something important has gone missing and nobody knows exactly what happened. Who could investigate and solve the mystery?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a detective. Detectives look for clues and solve mysteries.
quests.funFact: A detective looks closely at tiny clues that other people might miss.
quests.wordExample: The detective figured out the mystery of the missing bicycle.

quests.question: A big ship needs a whole team of people to sail safely across the ocean. Who works aboard as part of the crew?
quests.hint: A big ship needs a whole team of people to sail safely across the ocean. Who works aboard as part of the crew?
quests.explanation: Well done! This is a sailor. Sailors work on a ship and help it travel across the sea.
quests.funFact: A sailor learns to tie many different kinds of rope knots.
quests.wordExample: The sailor steered the ship through the calm sea.

quests.question: You want a nice-smelling candle to brighten up your room. Who made it?
quests.hint: You want a nice-smelling candle to brighten up your room. Who made it?
quests.explanation: You got it! This is a candle maker. Candle makers melt and shape wax into candles.
quests.funFact: Candle makers carefully pour warm wax into molds to shape it.
quests.wordExample: The candle maker poured warm wax into a mold.
